messages:
Katie: Heads up — I'm bringing my niece (2yo) and a stroller today at 4:15pm. Also expecting a small drone demo delivery for the demo team (~4:05). Need a temp visitor badge, a stroller locker, and a quick couch spot in the lobby. Can front desk help? cc @frontdesk
Front Desk (Bot): Got it — please reply with the visitor name and org so we can print a badge. :white_check_mark:
Katie: Name = Maya Cruz, org = LumaPlay. Stroller is foldable. Drone package labeled 'DELTA-DRONE-LP' — fragile, contains a separated battery pack (vendor note).
CourierBot: ETA 16:06 for DELTA-DRONE-LP. Photo uploaded: https://img.redwood.test/delta-drone.jpg
Mike: We can hold the stroller in locker B12 (near mailwall). I'll set a temporary code for today. If it doesn't fit, we can move to supply closet A.
Anya: I'll be at the counter at 4:10 to hand out the badge. Which badge color do you want? I usually do VISITOR-GREEN for short visits.
Devon: I can help carry the stroller from the bike rack if it arrives early.
Katie: Thanks — VISITOR-GREEN works. Also — is it okay to leave the drone charger (sealed) at the desk? Vendor says it's separated from the drone.
Mike: If the battery/charger is packaged and labeled, we can store it in the secure locker. Loose lithium packs we can't accept. CourierBot, is the battery packaged?
CourierBot: Battery packed in manufacturer box and labeled "Li-ion pack — installed removed" per shipper notes. Clearance ok for temporary hold.
Front Desk (Bot): Badge ready: "Maya Cruz — LumaPlay" printed and waiting at the counter. Locker B12 assigned; temp code set to `4231`. Locker will auto-reset and log out at 20:00.
Katie: Quick poll — who wants the lobby couch to sit on while we wait? React with :couch:. Maya will probably take the far end.
Anya: :couch:
Devon: :couch:
Mike: :thumbsup: (I'll stand by the locker in case someone needs help)
Katie: Perfect — thank you all! I'll update if ETA changes. :heart:
